services.name: Statistical analysis and modelling
services.summary: Rigorous analysis that answers your questions with the right tests and models, written up so non-specialists can act on it.
questions: Is the difference between groups real, or chance?
Which factors are linked to the outcome we care about?
How big is the effect, and how sure can we be?
deliverables: Tables and charts ready for your report
A plain-language summary of what the results mean
The analysis files or code, so the work can be repeated
services.methods: Descriptive statistics, hypothesis tests, regression (linear, logistic, multilevel), ANOVA, factor and cluster analysis.

services.name: Survey data analysis and weighting
services.summary: Turn survey responses into reliable estimates for your population, with the right weights and margins of error.
questions: What share of the population has this characteristic, by region or group?
Has the situation changed since the last round?
How confident can we be in these estimates?
deliverables: A short methods note on sampling and weighting
services.methods: Design weights, non-response adjustment, complex survey estimation, indices and scales, trend analysis.

services.name: Monitoring, evaluation and impact analysis
services.summary: Measure what programmes achieve: indicator tracking, evaluation analysis and estimates of impact.
questions: Are we on track against our targets?
What difference did the programme make, and for whom?
Which parts of the programme work best?
deliverables: Indicator calculations against baselines and targets
Impact estimates with their limitations explained

about.mission: To help organisations, governments and NGOs make better decisions and deliver results, by building their people's skills in data, research and leadership, and by providing reliable data and independent analysis.
about.vision: An Africa where every organisation, government and NGO has the data, evidence and skilled people it needs to make good decisions and deliver results.

values.title: Rigour
values.text: Methods and advice that are sound, transparent and honestly reported.

values.title: Practicality
values.text: Training and solutions that work in real organisations, field conditions and budgets.

values.title: Evidence-led leadership
values.text: Helping leaders use data and evidence to set priorities and make decisions.

values.title: Ethics and data protection
values.text: Respect for participants, informed consent and careful handling of personal data.

values.title: Building capacity
values.text: Leaving people and organisations more skilled, and more independent, than we found them.
